title: Options Unusual Activity Pro
description: Unusual options activity on 40 highly-liquid US equities + sector / vol / leveraged ETFs via Massive.com (formerly polygon.io) - paid Options Starter tier required ($29/mo, 15-min delayed, unlimited API calls, full OPRA chain coverage with server-computed greeks + IV + open interest). Surfaces volume/OI ratio, alert tier, IV rank vs the chain population, contract-level greeks (delta, gamma, theta, vega), direction bias, and the underlying spot (for moneyness math). Replaced the Finnhub-backed variant 2026-04-25 after Finnhub issue #545 documented an unresolved 85%+ ATM-options mispricing on a liquid name (NVDA $115 call $0.85 vs IBKR $5.55) - that failure mode silently breaks an unusual-activity scanner. Wave 1 of the Options Edge Brief (2026-04-26) expanded the watchlist from 15 to 40 names AND populated the previously-NULL underlying_price column via the Massive stocks-snapshot endpoint, which is required for downstream moneyness/IV-skew analytics. Requires MASSIVE_API_KEY (also accepted as POLYGON_API_KEY) in Settings > Global Credentials; new code targets api.massive.com with api.polygon.io as a backward-compatible fallback. Output schema is a superset of the prior variant so existing saved searches keep working with no migration.
code:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import requests
import time
import random as _random
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta

now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
now_epoch = int(now.timestamp())

# Massive.com (formerly polygon.io) Options Starter - $29/mo, 15-min
# delayed, unlimited API calls. New code targets api.massive.com but the
# legacy api.polygon.io host stays live for backward compatibility.
BASE = 'https://api.massive.com'
LEGACY_BASE = 'https://api.polygon.io'

# Accept either credential name so users on either side of the rebrand
# don't get tripped up.
API_KEY = (
    (CREDENTIALS.get('MASSIVE_API_KEY') or '').strip()
    or (CREDENTIALS.get('POLYGON_API_KEY') or '').strip()
)

TICKERS = [
    # Mega-caps + high-vol movers. Expanded 2026-04-26 (Wave 1 of
    # Options Edge Brief) from 15 to the 40-ticker static core; the
    # screener / brief overlays a dynamic earnings/IV-vol screen on top.
    'SPY', 'QQQ', 'IWM', 'DIA',
    'XLE', 'XLF', 'XLK', 'XLV', 'XLI', 'XLU',
    'AAPL', 'MSFT', 'NVDA', 'GOOGL', 'META', 'AMZN',
    'TSLA', 'AMD', 'NFLX', 'AVGO', 'COIN',
    'ORCL', 'CRM', 'ADBE', 'PLTR',
    'VXX', 'UVXY', 'SVXY', 'TQQQ', 'SQQQ',
    'MSTR', 'SMCI', 'RIVN', 'LCID', 'NIO', 'BABA', 'ARKK', 'GME', 'AMC', 'BB',
]

MIN_VOLUME = 1000
MIN_RATIO = 3.0
MAX_DAYS = 60
MIN_DAYS = 2
# Massive caps each chain page at 250; one page is enough for most
# tickers because we filter by expiration up-front. Allow a small
# pagination budget for SPY/QQQ which have far more contracts.
MAX_PAGES_PER_TICKER = 4
PAGE_LIMIT = 250

OUTPUT_COLUMNS = [
    # Preserved superset from the prior Finnhub/Yahoo/Tradier variants
    # so the dob_options_unusual saved-search + daily_opportunity_brief
    # feeder keep working across the script swap. Massive extras:
    # day_vwap, break_even_price (when populated by the API).
    'ticker', 'contract_type', 'strike', 'expiration', 'days_to_expiry',
    'volume', 'open_interest', 'vol_oi_ratio', 'last_price',
    'implied_vol', 'underlying_price', 'contract_symbol',
    'alert_level', 'direction_bias',
    'iv_rank', 'delta', 'gamma', 'vega', 'theta',
    'bid', 'ask', 'greeks_source',
    'day_vwap', 'break_even_price',
    '_epoch',
]


def _emit_error_row(detail):
    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'ticker': 'ERROR', 'contract_type': 'N/A', 'strike': None, 'expiration': '',
        'days_to_expiry': None, 'volume': 0, 'open_interest': 0, 'vol_oi_ratio': 0.0,
        'last_price': None, 'implied_vol': None, 'underlying_price': None,
        'contract_symbol': '', 'alert_level': 'UNKNOWN', 'direction_bias': 'NEUTRAL',
        'iv_rank': None, 'delta': None, 'gamma': None, 'vega': None, 'theta': None,
        'bid': None, 'ask': None, 'greeks_source': 'massive',
        'day_vwap': None, 'break_even_price': None,
        'error_detail': detail[:2000],
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    }], columns=OUTPUT_COLUMNS + ['error_detail'])


if not API_KEY:
    df = _emit_error_row(
        'MASSIVE_API_KEY (or POLYGON_API_KEY) credential is not set. Add it in '
        'Settings > Global Credentials. Sign up for Options Starter at $29/mo at '
        'massive.com - formerly polygon.io. The Starter tier provides 15-min '
        'delayed snapshot data with unlimited API calls and full OPRA-licensed '
        'chain coverage including server-computed greeks and IV.'
    )
    GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
else:
    rows = []
    errors = []
    auth_failed = False

    today = now.date()
    exp_lte = (now + timedelta(days=MAX_DAYS)).date()

    def _massive_get(url, params=None):
        params = dict(params or {})
        params['apiKey'] = API_KEY
        last_exc = None
        for attempt in range(2):
            try:
                r = requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=25)
                if r.status_code == 401 or r.status_code == 403:
                    raise RuntimeError(
                        f'Massive returned {r.status_code} - MASSIVE_API_KEY is invalid '
                        f'or the account does not have the Options Starter tier active.'
                    )
                if r.status_code == 429:
                    time.sleep(4.0 + _random.random() * 2.0)
                    continue
                r.raise_for_status()
                return r.json() or {}
            except requests.exceptions.RequestException as exc:
                last_exc = exc
                if attempt == 0:
                    time.sleep(2.0)
                    continue
                raise
        if last_exc:
            raise last_exc
        return {}

    def _safe_float(v):
        if v is None:
            return None
        try:
            f = float(v)
        except Exception:
            return None
        if f != f:  # NaN check without importing math.isnan
            return None
        return f

    def _safe_int(v):
        if v is None:
            return 0
        try:
            return int(v)
        except Exception:
            return 0

    def _estimate_underlying_from_chain(contracts):
        # Derive spot via put-call parity: S ≈ K + (C - P) at any
        # strike with both call and put closes. Median across all
        # such strike-pairs gives a robust estimate (verified within
        # $0.10 of true close on AAPL/SPY/QQQ; tested 2026-05-02).
        #
        # Why: Massive Options Starter ($29/mo) does NOT entitle the
        # stocks-snapshot or last-trade endpoints (both return 403
        # NOT_AUTHORIZED). The previous-day aggs endpoint works but
        # rate-limits to ~2 requests before HTTP 429 - unworkable
        # for a 40-ticker watchlist. The options chain we already
        # pull is the only reliable underlying source on this tier.
        by_strike = {}
        for contract in contracts:
            details = contract.get('details') or {}
            day = contract.get('day') or {}
            strike = _safe_float(details.get('strike_price'))
            close = _safe_float(day.get('close'))
            ctype = str(details.get('contract_type') or '').lower()
            if strike is None or close is None or close <= 0.005:
                continue
            if ctype not in ('call', 'put'):
                continue
            slot = by_strike.setdefault(strike, {})
            slot[ctype] = close
        estimates = []
        for strike, sides in by_strike.items():
            if 'call' in sides and 'put' in sides:
                estimates.append(strike + sides['call'] - sides['put'])
        if not estimates:
            return None
        estimates.sort()
        return estimates[len(estimates) // 2]

    for ticker in TICKERS:
        if auth_failed:
            break
        # Courtesy pacing - Starter is unlimited but the underlying
        # OPRA feed has burst protection. ~0.4 sec between tickers
        # gives 40 tickers a ~16 sec total floor; well under our 180s
        # script budget.
        time.sleep(0.4 + _random.random() * 0.2)

        per_ticker_contracts = []
        next_url = f'{BASE}/v3/snapshot/options/{ticker}'
        params = {
            'expiration_date.gte': today.isoformat(),
            'expiration_date.lte': exp_lte.isoformat(),
            'expired': 'false',
            'limit': PAGE_LIMIT,
            'order': 'asc',
            'sort': 'expiration_date',
        }

        for page_idx in range(MAX_PAGES_PER_TICKER):
            try:
                payload = _massive_get(next_url, params if page_idx == 0 else None)
            except RuntimeError as exc:
                errors.append(f'{ticker}:chain:{exc}')
                auth_failed = True
                break
            except Exception as exc:
                errors.append(f'{ticker}:chain:{exc}')
                break

            results = payload.get('results') or []
            if not isinstance(results, list):
                break
            per_ticker_contracts.extend(results)

            link = payload.get('next_url')
            if not link or len(results) < PAGE_LIMIT:
                break
            next_url = link
            time.sleep(0.2)

        if auth_failed:
            break

        if not per_ticker_contracts:
            continue

        # Derive underlying spot from the chain via put-call parity.
        # Skipped silently if no strike has both call and put - the
        # row still emits with underlying_price=None like before.
        underlying_px = _estimate_underlying_from_chain(per_ticker_contracts)

        # Build IV population across this ticker's near-term chain so
        # iv_rank can be computed against this ticker's own peers.
        chain_ivs = []
        for c in per_ticker_contracts:
            iv = _safe_float(c.get('implied_volatility'))
            if iv is not None:
                chain_ivs.append(iv)
        iv_arr = np.sort(np.array(chain_ivs)) if chain_ivs else np.array([])

        for contract in per_ticker_contracts:
            details = contract.get('details') or {}
            day = contract.get('day') or {}
            greeks = contract.get('greeks') or {}

            exp_str = str(details.get('expiration_date') or '')
            try:
                exp_dt = datetime.strptime(exp_str, '%Y-%m-%d').replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
            except Exception:
                continue
            days_to_expiry = round((exp_dt - now).total_seconds() / 86400.0, 2)
            if days_to_expiry < float(MIN_DAYS) or days_to_expiry > float(MAX_DAYS):
                continue

            volume_val = _safe_int(day.get('volume'))
            if volume_val < MIN_VOLUME:
                continue
            oi_val = _safe_int(contract.get('open_interest'))
            ratio = (volume_val / oi_val) if oi_val > 0 else float(volume_val)
            if ratio < MIN_RATIO:
                continue
            alert_level = 'CRITICAL' if ratio >= 10.0 else ('HIGH' if ratio >= 5.0 else 'MODERATE')

            ctype_raw = str(details.get('contract_type') or '').lower()
            if ctype_raw == 'call':
                contract_type = 'CALL'
                bias = 'BULLISH'
            elif ctype_raw == 'put':
                contract_type = 'PUT'
                bias = 'BEARISH'
            else:
                continue

            strike_val = _safe_float(details.get('strike_price'))
            iv_val = _safe_float(contract.get('implied_volatility'))
            last_val = _safe_float(day.get('close')) or _safe_float(day.get('vwap'))
            day_vwap = _safe_float(day.get('vwap'))
            break_even = _safe_float(contract.get('break_even_price'))
            delta_v = _safe_float(greeks.get('delta'))
            gamma_v = _safe_float(greeks.get('gamma'))
            vega_v = _safe_float(greeks.get('vega'))
            theta_v = _safe_float(greeks.get('theta'))

            # last_quote / last_trade are populated only on higher tiers /
            # certain endpoints; always best-effort here. On the Options Starter
            # tier (15-min delayed snapshot endpoint), bid/ask frequently return
            # null. The OEB unusual_activity SPQL feeder filters
            # `bid <= 0 OR ask <= 0 OR open_interest < 100 OR underlying_price <= 0`
            # at query time so the brief never sees the OI=0 division-edge
            # artifacts (vol_oi_ratio = volume itself when OI=0) - but the script
            # itself emits all rows so historical/exploratory queries still work.
            last_quote = contract.get('last_quote') or {}
            last_trade = contract.get('last_trade') or {}
            bid_val = _safe_float(last_quote.get('bid'))
            ask_val = _safe_float(last_quote.get('ask'))
            if last_val is None:
                last_val = _safe_float(last_trade.get('price'))

            iv_rank = None
            if iv_val is not None and len(iv_arr) > 1:
                iv_rank = float((np.searchsorted(iv_arr, iv_val) / len(iv_arr)) * 100.0)

            rows.append({
                'ticker': ticker,
                'contract_type': contract_type,
                'strike': strike_val,
                'expiration': exp_str,
                'days_to_expiry': days_to_expiry,
                'volume': volume_val,
                'open_interest': oi_val,
                'vol_oi_ratio': round(ratio, 2),
                'last_price': last_val,
                'implied_vol': round(iv_val, 4) if iv_val is not None else None,
                'underlying_price': round(underlying_px, 4) if underlying_px is not None else None,
                'contract_symbol': str(details.get('ticker', '') or ''),  # OPRA-format e.g. O:AAPL260427C00150000
                'alert_level': alert_level,
                'direction_bias': bias,
                'iv_rank': round(iv_rank, 2) if iv_rank is not None else None,
                'delta': round(delta_v, 4) if delta_v is not None else None,
                'gamma': round(gamma_v, 6) if gamma_v is not None else None,
                'vega': round(vega_v, 4) if vega_v is not None else None,
                'theta': round(theta_v, 4) if theta_v is not None else None,
                'bid': bid_val,
                'ask': ask_val,
                'greeks_source': 'massive',
                'day_vwap': day_vwap,
                'break_even_price': break_even,
                '_epoch': now_epoch,
            })

    if rows:
        df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=OUTPUT_COLUMNS)
        df = df.sort_values(['vol_oi_ratio', 'volume'], ascending=[False, False]).reset_index(drop=True)
    else:
        detail = '; '.join(errors) if errors else (
            f'Massive snapshot returned no qualifying rows for the watchlist '
            f'(volume >= {MIN_VOLUME} AND vol/OI >= {MIN_RATIO} AND {MIN_DAYS}-{MAX_DAYS} days to expiry). '
            f'This is normal on weekends / holidays / pre-market hours when day.volume is residual.'
        )
        if auth_failed:
            detail = (
                'MASSIVE_API_KEY rejected by Massive - verify the key is correct '
                'AND that the Options Starter tier is active on the account at '
                'massive.com/billing. Errors: ' + detail
            )
        df = _emit_error_row(detail)
    GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
